name: DeepSeek-R1
notes: Architecturally IDENTICAL to DeepSeek-V3 - config model_type is deepseek_v3 with the same 61 layers, 256 routed + 1 shared expert, 8 per token, kv_lora_rank 512, YaRN factor 40. R1 is a post-training release (RL with verifiable rewards) over the V3 base, not a new architecture, so it inherits V3's serving economics exactly: 61 x 576 x 2 = 70,272 B/token (68.6 KiB). Recorded separately because a reader looking up 'R1' should not have to know it is a V3. Distills are different architectures - see deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-32b. safetensors total 684.49B, essentially identical to V3's 684.53B, consistent with the same architecture.
